title: Production and Targeting of Monovalent Quantum Dots
protocol: Dilute 200 µl of a 1 µM solution of organic phase QDs with 400 µl of chloroform in a 5 ml glass vial.
Mix 400 µl of a 0.3 M tetrabutylammonium bromide (TBAB) chloroform solution with 36 µl of neat mPEG thiol and shake overnight.
Add 800 µl of a 0.2 M NaOH aqueous solution to the mixture and shake for 30 seconds.
Concentrate the collected QDs with a Centricon spin column (30 kDa molecular weight cut-off) to 1 ml.
Add the concentrated QD solution into a Sephadex NAP10 column pre-equilibrated with 10 mM Tris buffer containing 30 mM NaCl (pH 8.0).
Elute the QDs with 1.5 ml of elution buffer by gravity flow.
Measure the concentration of QDs with absorption spectroscopy at 350 nm.
Prepare a 1 ml solution of 100 nM QD in 10 mM Tris buffer containing 30 mM NaCl at pH 8.
Add dropwise 500 μl of the 100 nM ptDNA solution to the aqueous QDs for 1 minute while vigorously stirring.
Stir or place on a shaker the mixture for an additional 9 hours.
Remove approximately 10 μl of the QD mixture for analytical agarose gel analysis.
Also remove a similar concentration of unconjugated QDs in aqueous phase from step 1.2.1.
Add about 2 μl of 6x Ficoll loading buffer to each sample.
Run these two samples together on a 0.8% wt/v agarose gel in sodium borate buffer for 15 minutes at 150 V.
Calculate the unconjugated QD fraction using the relative intensity of two bands.
Use the calculated fraction to determine the volume of 100 nM ptDNA solution needed to match the number of QDs.
Repeat steps involving conjugation until the QDs form a single band on the gel, indicating complete conjugation.
Add 100 µl of 10 mM (CO2H)CH2O(CH2CH2O)6C11H23SH in 10 mM Tris buffer with 30 mM NaCl to the conjugated mQDs and shake for 10 min.
Incubate the mixture for approximately 30 minutes.
Add 0.5 ml of QD solution to a sephadex NAP5 column pre-equilibrated with elution buffer.
Collect the QDs with 1.0 ml of elution buffer by gravity flow.
Concentrate the collected QDs using a Centricon spin column (30 kDa).
Store the concentrated mQDs at 4 °C for months.
Produce or purchase amine-terminated DNA using the sequence 5’-NH2-(CT)10-(CAGT)5-3’.
Dissolve BG-N-hydroxysuccinimide (BG-NHS) in dry dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) at a concentration of 10 mg/ml.
Mix BG-NHS in DMSO with amine-terminated DNA in HEPES buffered (pH 8.5) water.
Carry out the reaction using 20 µl of 10 mg/ml BG-NHS in DMSO and 2 µl of 2 mM NH2-(CT)10-(CAGT)5 in 58 µl deionized water buffered with 20 µl 0.5 M HEPES pH 8.5.
Sonicate the reaction mixture for 5–10 min to ensure thorough mixing.
Incubate the reaction mixture for approximately 1 hour at room temperature (RT).
Desalt the reaction using a standard NAP5 column into 100 mM triethylamine acetate (TEAA, pH 7).
Purify the BG-DNA from unreacted amine-DNA by reversed-phase HPLC running a gradient between 8% and 95% acetonitrile over 30 min.
Collect the BG-DNA fraction in a conical tube after purification.
Use a C18 Zorbax column for standard oligonucleotide purification with a gradient of 0→15 min: 8→30% ACN, 15→21 min: 30–90% ACN, 21→25 min: 90→8% ACN, and 25→30 min: 8% ACN.
Freeze the collected fraction in liquid nitrogen and lyophilize it to remove water.
Resuspend the DNA in deionized water after lyophilization.
Lyophilize two more times to completely remove residual TEAA.
Resuspend the final product in deionized water after ensuring removal of all residual TEAA.
Resuspend the lyophilized BG-DNA in water.
Wash the sides of the tube while resuspending.
Dilute to approximately 25 µM stock concentration.
Aliquot and store at 4 °C.
Passivate mQDs just prior to an imaging experiment using reagents such as casein or BSA.
Plate cells expressing the SNAP-tagged protein on TIRF-quality glass.
Allow cells to attach to the glass for about 24 hours.
Remove growth media from the cells.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Incubate cells in approximately 100-150 µl of PBS or cell media containing ~1 µM BG-DNA for 10–30 minutes at room temperature.
Carefully wash the cells with PBS or cell media after incubation with BG-DNA.
Incubate cells with mQDs produced in step 1.2.9 for approximately 5-10 minutes.
Optionally, wash unbound mQDs to remove them from the cells.
Return cells to a buffer/media suitable for imaging and culture if necessary.
Image the cells using a TIRF microscope.
